BUTTERFLY TRUST
                           DESIGNATION AND ACCEPTANCE OF SU_CCESSOR TRUSTEE


                        Pursuant to the provisions of Article SIXTH of the BUTTERFLY TRUST,
                created under that certain trust agreement dated December 27, 2006 (the "Trust'),
                the undersigned Trustees, DARREN K. INDYKE and RICHARD KAHN, being the sole
                Trustees of the Trust, hereby designate ERIKA A. KELLERHALS as a successor
                Trustee of the Trust, effective immediately upon the death, resignation or removal
                of either or both of DARREN K. INDYKE or RICHARD KAHN as Trustee of the Trust
                and upon the said designated successor Trustee's qualification by executing this
                instrument to evidence her acceptance of such designation and her agreement to
                execute her duties as Trustee to the best of her ability.

                Dated:        October 31, 2014



                                                                DARREN K. INDY



                                                                RICHARD KAHN, Trustee



                       The undersigned, ERIKA A. KELLERHALS, hereby accepts the foregoing
                designation as successor Trustee under the provisions of trust agreement dated
                December 27, 2006 of the BUTTERFLY TRUST and hereby agrees to execute her
                duties as Trustee thereof to the best of her ability.

                Dated:        October 31, 2014




                                                               ERIKA A KELLERHALS,Trus e




               Receipt acknowledged by:



               JEFFREY E. EPSTEIN, ttr5-fffin
